scenario.title: Unexpected Farewell at the Farmer's Market
scenario.context: Saturday morning at a bustling farmer's market. The air is filled with the scent of fresh produce, baked goods, and aromatic coffee. A local band is playing a lively tune in the background. The sky is cloudless and the sun is bright.
scenario.description: During a routine visit to the farmer's market, childhood friends, Kiera and Preet, unexpectedly cross paths at the organic vegetables stall. Kiera, who just returned from a long trip abroad, shares the news that she has decided to move to another city permanently.
scenario.speaker1_role: Childhood friend who is planning to move away
scenario.speaker1_persona: Open-hearted, sociable, and sensitive, Kiera is someone who values her relationships deeply. She has a knack for reading people's emotions and responding in an empathetic manner.
scenario.speaker2_role: Childhood friend surprised by the news
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Preet is warm, understanding, and emotionally attuned. He is able to empathize with Kiera's decision and expresses his feelings in a supportive manner.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Preet is prone to emotional reactivity and tends to express his feelings in a defensive manner. He struggles to empathize with Kiera's decision and reacts with frustration and disbelief.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Preet tends to suppress his emotions, resulting in a detached and indifferent response. He avoids expressing his feelings and struggles to show empathy towards Kiera's decision.
scenario.speaker2_persona_high: High EQ - Preet is warm, understanding, and emotionally attuned. He is able to empathize with Kiera's decision and expresses his feelings in a supportive manner.
scenario.speaker2_persona_low: Low EQ - Preet is prone to emotional reactivity and tends to express his feelings in a defensive manner. He struggles to empathize with Kiera's decision and reacts with frustration and disbelief.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Preet, it's so good to see you! I've got some news, I've decided to move to Chicago permanently.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Wow, Kiera! That's... unexpected. I mean, it's great, but it's going to be different without you here.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: I know, it's a big change. But I feel it's the right thing for me right now.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: I'm really going to miss you, Kiera. But I'm happy for you if it's what you want.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Thank you, Preet. I'm going to miss you too. But don't worry, we'll find ways to keep in touch.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Yeah, you're right. We'll make it work. Just promise me you'll come back to visit sometimes.
